title: Quick Savory Italian Cheese Cacio E Pepe
description: A salty, snappy, and comforting Italian dish featuring flour tortilla and high-protein cheese, perfect for a sick day. This recipe is a creative twist on the classic cacio e pepe.

ingredients.name: flour tortilla
ingredients.notes: use high fiber tortilla for extra nutrition

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs and a pinch of salt.
Add the shredded grana padano and parmesan cheese to the bowl and mix well.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the flour tortilla to the skillet and cook for 2 minutes on each side.
Transfer the tortilla to a baking dish and spoon the egg and cheese mixture on top.
Sprinkle the chopped parsley and black pepper over the top.
Bake the cacio e pepe in the preheated oven for 15 minutes.
Remove from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
